# toCamelCase

<link-summary>Joins the words of a string into camelCase.</link-summary>

<web-summary>toCamelCase() — Joins the words of a string into camelCase. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function toCamelCase(value: string, options: ToCamelCaseOptions = {}): string;
```

Each word is capitalised, the separators between words are dropped, and the first letter is lowered unless `firstWordToLowerCase` is `false`. With `clean` left on, anything that is not a letter or a digit is removed as well.

Word boundaries are the ones a regular expression sees, so spaces and hyphens separate words but an underscore does not: `"user_first_name"` comes back as `"userfirstname"`, not `"userFirstName"`.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                 | Description                                                                                                                 |
| :---------------------------- | :------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                       | `string`             | The string to convert. It must not be empty.                                                                                |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `ToCamelCaseOptions` | `clean` strips non-alphanumeric characters (on by default); `firstWordToLowerCase` lowers the first letter (on by default). |

## Returns

`string` — the converted string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
toCamelCase("Hello world! How are you?"); // => "helloWorldHowAreYou"
toCamelCase("Hello world!", { firstWordToLowerCase: false }); // => "HelloWorld"
toCamelCase("user_first_name"); // => "userfirstname"
```
